scope: body, ingestion, containers, polymorph, herds, brief secrets

findings.claim: Materials attach contact statuses through legacy status_effects or structured Stains. OILED, like WET, is marked as fire protection on the body; loose oil is burnable. The summary that oil feeds fire must distinguish loose fuel from coating.
opaque: Exact coating replacement, washing and ignition order are implemented by native systems, not reconstructed here.

findings.claim: Ingestion has its own per-material dose/effect rows. A useful stain may be harmful when drunk: invisibility liquid gives FOOD_POISONING by ingestion. Solids also have ingestion effects, so neither every liquid having an effect nor every material being consumable follows.
opaque: Native dose accumulation, effect decay and inheritance merge semantics are not fully reconstructed.

findings.claim: Status data has tiers rather than a uniform stack: INGESTION_DRUNK thresholds are 0, 0.25, 0.75 and 1, with POISONED added at 1. TRIP has four tiers; CURSE_CLOUD three. Effects carry finite frame durations and may have exclusivity groups.

Flasks hold mixtures indexed by material type and run reactions inside the inventory. The ordinary flask sucks up to barrel_size 1000 and enables reaction chance 20, explosions and entity outputs. Powder pouch has material_type 1, barrel_size 1500 and drinkable 0. One-material containers are an explicit YAIR simplification, not the observed Noita model.

Standard polymorph targets sheep for 600 frames and random polymorph uses the RANDOM target. Engine documentation exposes serialized original entity storage. A mass polymorph script targets both homing targets and player units, with boss and immunity exclusions. Restoring memories or a soul is YAIR design, not a Noita source fact.
opaque: Random candidate selection and native entity restoration are opaque in this Lua/XML audit.

findings.claim: Players, basic enemies and animals share damage/status component families, but authored parameters differ. Enemy AI has herd relations and aggression, not only tag matching. The directed relation matrix has 35 herds and 133 asymmetric unordered pairs. Shared mechanics do not imply identical susceptibility or universal friendly fire.

Orb pickups separate first discovery from later encounters: a first encounter creates a spell card from storage, a known orb creates a heart, and out-of-bounds orb IDs create evil hearts. Tablet offerings convert physical tablets to gold and repeated offerings may spawn monsters. These are concrete knowledge, place and history gates. Claims about community discovery dates are not established by the install.

touches.proposal: Keep wetness separate from clean: rain cools a body without removing every social stain.
Give oil two contexts: loose fuel burns; a fresh body coating can briefly shield ignition in a Noita-like world.
Show coat and drink outcomes separately in the material notebook.
Offer a small sip and a full drink with explicit dose, time and known outcome ranges.
Use tiered drunkenness: a small dose loosens speech, a large dose adds sickness.
A bottle can hold water and oil with separate amounts instead of converting both to a generic potion item.
Mixing may take time; shaking speeds the reaction but may trigger a volatile output sooner.
A cracked flask leaks into its place; breakage spills the remaining exact contents.
A powder pouch can scatter salt or coal but offers no drink verb.
A polymorphed body changes movement, food needs and available verbs while the person keeps knowledge.
Transformation consumes or clears its causing coat to prevent an immediate loop.
An unusual meal can give a timed resistance, distinct from learning a recipe or gaining permanent power.
A faction may tolerate another faction that still hates it: relations can be directed.
Keep aggression and relation separate: a hungry aggressive beast attacks sooner than a calm member of its herd.
Apply the same rain and fire rules to named NPCs, with body-specific immunity checks.
Display friendly-fire and self-hit rules on a technique instead of promising all hazards are universal.
First discovery of a hidden relic teaches a technique; later visits give a modest local resource.
A lore tablet can be read, thrown or offered at a shrine; each route consumes or keeps the same item explicitly.
Repeated shrine offerings change the next result and expose the count in the causal log after discovery.
Track discovery knowledge separately from current-world collection history.

coverage.method: Read-only local source and shipped component documentation; file paths relative to extracted data root or external root. No launch or runtime proof.
count_notes: Counts are declarations before CellDataChild inheritance, not the number of runtime edible materials.
One material, meat_slime_cursed, has two Ingestion blocks.
Lua commented BRAIN_DAMAGE entry excluded. Duplicate IDs are dose tiers.
XML counted with lxml without recovery errors; CSV cells counted directly.
